services.name: Newport Neighborhood Food Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a One-of-a-Kind Guided Tour for Rhode Island Natives and Visitors Alike Duration 3 - 3.5 Hours What is a Neighborhood Food & Cultural Walking Tour? Taste, Bite & Sip through little known historic neighborhoods and hotbeds of food and fun. Experience culinary tastings from a historic tavern, to a hip cafe, a deliberately curated bistro, and diverse ethnic eateries. Get tipped off to the most popular dishes and drinks including restaurants not on our tours. Explore the early colonial architecture and culture of Newport while we walk and share the neighborhood history. What's Included All food tastings, enough for a comfortable lunch (alcohol if purchased ticket) An entertaining guided

services.name: Downcity Providence Food Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a One-of-a-Kind Guided Tour for Rhode Island Natives and Visitors Alike Duration 3 - 3.5 Hours What is a Downcity Providence Food Tour? Savor 6+ tastings, bites & sips in one of America's Top Food Cities with a professional guide. Support locally owned restaurants, bakeries and purveyors that add flavor to the local food scene while we tip you off to their most popular dishes and drinks. Explore and learn about both the new and early architecture while listening to fascinating stories about the history of our capital city. See the beautiful and interesting murals, art and culture of the Creative Capital while we walk you through the Downcity Arts District. What's Included All

services.name: PVD Valley Neighborhood Victuals Tour
services.desc: A Unique Neighborhood & Market Experience Duration 3- 3.5 Hours What is a PVD Valley Neighborhood Victuals Tour? Learn about an inclusive neighborhood with a common thread of History, Community and Sustainability. Explore this new developing neighborhood in Providence within a former industrial corridor being transformed into a sprouting food hub. Hear about a non profit artist community that started it all. Meet the RI makers, artists, farmers, small businesses, farmers and chefs within a burgeoning food and drink production scene.
